snippet.title: Bizzleberry
snippet.description: Welcome to Bizzleberry's League of Legends channel, that largely focuses on the support aspect of the game. Bizzleberry provides content such as gameplay videos, support guides for all the supports in League of Legends and other helpful content based on League & Streaming! Bizzle is also a live streamer at www.twitch.tv/bizzleberry and he is also a mobafire guide writer. Expect videos at least twice a week to help improve your ELO in League of legends. If you have any questions feel free to leave a comment or visit the stream (he is online between 6pm - 9pm UK).
